Momentum Engineering, Inc. Openings

ME00608-MS Power Platform Developer

ME00608-MS Power Platform Developer

Momentum Engineering, Inc., a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB), fosters an employee-centric culture. Our strength lies in our people. With a high percentage of employees holding advanced degrees in engineering, computer science, and related disciplines, we bring deep technical expertise to every mission. Our team includes professionals with security clearances and full-scope polygraphs, ensuring trusted, secure support for the most sensitive national security initiatives. Additionally, our workforce is equipped with industry-leading certifications, demonstrating a commitment to continuous learning and excellence. Most importantly, our exceptional employee retention rate reflects a culture of professional growth, mission focus, and dedication—ensuring long-term stability and expertise for our customers’ critical needs.

Job Summary

The Microsoft Power Platform Administrator / SharePoint Developer will support the customer in delivering technology solutions to enhance the effectiveness of analysts and operational staff
The successful candidate will maintain and enhance existing applications and dashboards built on Microsoft Power Platform and SharePoint, while designing and developing new tools that streamline workflows, improve data visibility, and support mission objectives
This position requires a combination of hands-on technical expertise, analytical problem-solving, and close collaboration with analysts and stakeholders in a high-security, data-driven environment

Primary Responsibilities

Maintain, optimize, and troubleshoot existing Power Apps, Power Automate flows, and Power BI dashboards
Design, build, and deploy new Power Apps and Power BI dashboards that meet end-user requirements
Manage Power Platform environments, connections, permissions, and data gateways
Develop automation and workflow solutions to streamline processes for client base
Implement data governance, security, and compliance best practices within the Power Platform ecosystem
Design and deploy new SharePoint solutions integrated with Power Apps and Power Automate
Ensure reliability, accessibility, and security of SharePoint-based applications and content 
Engage directly with customers to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Provide user support, documentation, and training for applications and dashboards
Work with IT security teams to ensure all solutions align with information assurance and cybersecurity standards
Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues, and recommend continuous improvements

Required Qualifications

U.S. Citizenship and active TS/SCI Clearance
Maintain, optimize, and troubleshoot existing Power Apps, Power Automate flows, and Power BI dashboards
Design, build, and deploy new Power Apps and Power BI dashboards that meet end-user requirements
Manage Power Platform environments, connections, permissions, and data gateways
Develop automation and workflow solutions to streamline processes for client base
Implement data governance, security, and compliance best practices within the Power Platform ecosystem
Design and deploy new SharePoint solutions integrated with Power Apps and Power Automate
Ensure reliability, accessibility, and security of SharePoint-based applications and content
Engage directly with customers to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Provide user support, documentation, and training for applications and dashboards
Work with IT security teams to ensure all solutions align with information assurance and cybersecurity standards
Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues, and recommend continuous improvements
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality, secure solutions
Ability to balance multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment
Self-starter with a collaborative mindset and customer-service orientation

Desired Qualifications

Experience supporting federal intelligence/law enforcement clients
Experience with JSON, REST APIs, or integrating external data sources

Exempt hourly position.  11 paid holidays, minimum of 3 weeks PTO, company sponsored group medical plan, company paid dental, vision, life insurance, and STD/LTD plans.  Salary is dependent upon the candidate’s experience and qualifications.
